limitations: This inventory covers the saved, scoped 99-target workspace, not the whole Pharos database or full upstream resources.
Pharos target publication discovery is capped at 25 records per target; 90 of 99 targets were capped. The saved 2403 target-publication occurrences are not a complete literature search.
Most graph evidence records do not carry an explicit supporting PMID. Absence here cannot establish absence from Pharos or from its upstream source.
STRING functional scores and source labels do not enumerate all supporting experiment or curated-database publications in this saved graph. Those upstream papers remain unassessed.
CIViC retrieved/excluded references are not equivalent to usable or accepted local assertions.
A shared PMID does not establish an identical claim; a different PMID does not establish an independent experiment, study population or data set.
Topic similarity, citation connection or new-to-this-inventory status does not establish support or contradiction of the KRAS G12D response claim.
No new article status, full text, retraction/correction audit or scientific accuracy determination is performed by this offline baseline.
Only two existing seed papers and default unfiltered 50-record neighborhoods were tested.
No comparison against PubMed Similar Articles or systematic-review recall was performed.
The other 80 unique records have not been assessed for exact-claim relevance.
Source-reported comments are not retractions; blank metadata is not publication-status clearance.
No full-text synthesis, study-independence audit, contradiction adjudication, clinical advice or gold-label evaluation was performed.
